newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Four miners killed at Western Deep plant.
newsitem.headline: Four miners killed at Western Deep plant.

text.p: Four mineworkers were killed at a Western Deep Levels Ltd gold plant west of Johannesburg on Saturday night, mineowners Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Sunday.
Anglo said in a statement the men had been reported missing after a 10-minute breakdown at the Carletonville plant at about 2000 GMT on Saturday.
Their bodies were found inside one of the plant's mills early on Sunday.
"The four had no work-related reason to be inside the mill during the breakdown," said Anglo spokesman James Duncan.
"The circumstances leading to their deaths, in particular how they gained unauthorised access to the mill, are being investigated," Duncan added, giving no further details.
